subject: general
question: According to the standard definition of Census of India, the marginal worker is a person who works for less than _______ days in a year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**183**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census of India, a **marginal worker** is defined as a person who worked for less than 183 days in a year.
 
• Marginal workers are distinguished from **main workers**, who work for 183 days or more annually.
 
• Marginal workers contribute to economic activities on a part-time basis or during specific seasons.
 
• The classification of workers into marginal and main categories helps in assessing the degree of employment stability and dependency in the workforce.
 
• This categorization is crucial for understanding labor market dynamics and designing targeted policies for employment generation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Census of India**

 
 
• Conducted every 10 years, the Census is the largest single source of statistical data on population, workforce, and socio-economic parameters in India.
 
• The Census categorizes workers into main workers, marginal workers, and non-workers.
 
• The latest Census was conducted in 2011, and the next is expected in the near future.
 
 
 
• **Workforce Classification**
 
 
• Workers are classified as **cultivators, agricultural laborers, household industry workers,** and **other workers** based on their primary occupation.
 
• Marginal workers are often engaged in seasonal agricultural activities or casual labor.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Marginal Workers**
 
 
• Marginal workers play a crucial role in sectors requiring temporary or seasonal labor, such as agriculture and construction.
 
• Their participation highlights the prevalence of underemployment and dependency on informal sectors.
 
 
 
• **Employment Challenges**
 
 
• The presence of marginal workers indicates challenges in ensuring **stable employment opportunities** for the population.
 
• Government schemes such as MGNREGA aim to address these challenges by providing 100 days of guaranteed wage employment to rural households.
